svg.title: China · early cultures and dynasties
svg.desc: Selected, sourced connections. Arrows label unions, divisions, conquest, independence, changes in rule, and contact. Node positions do not measure time or ancestry. Archaeological influence, later tradition and political change are distinct links. Continue from Song in the existing Mongols and China map for Yuan, Ming, Qing, ROC, PRC and Taiwan-era histories. Select a node for Wikipedia or an arrow for its sources.
svg.text: Tap a node to read · Tap an arrow for the event and sources
